title: Collections Thresholds for Home Comfort Financing
content:
Collections desk thresholds for Home Comfort Financing accounts, in days past due.

| Plan | Account becomes delinquent at | Late payment reported to the credit bureaus at | Delinquent account charged off at |
|---|---|---|---|
| 12-Month Same-As-Cash Deferred Interest Plan | 30 days past due | 30 days past due | 120 days past due |
| 18-Month 0% APR Equal Payment Plan | 30 days past due | 30 days past due | 120 days past due |
| 36-Month 0% APR Equal Payment Plan | 30 days past due | 30 days past due | 120 days past due |
| 60-Month 5.99% APR Fixed-Rate Plan | 30 days past due | 30 days past due | 120 days past due |
| 120-Month 7.99% APR Fixed-Rate Plan | 30 days past due | 30 days past due | 120 days past due |
| 144-Month 9.99% APR Fixed-Rate Plan | 30 days past due | 30 days past due | 120 days past due |

The thresholds are uniform across the six plans: delinquency and credit-bureau reporting both at 30 days past due, charge-off at 120 days past due.
